Application Description

This app plus your ears equals complete freedom in writing music! A comprehensive set of tools for any musician: * Chord Progression: Create beautiful chord progressions with full flexibility - use inversions, sus2, sus4, 7th, 9th, and more. Enjoy live playback as piano or synth, or send MIDI directly to your macOS computer! * Guitar Chords - helps you find and browse guitar chords. * MIDI Keyboard: Transform your phone into a MIDI keyboard for your macOS computer (compatible with macOS Catalina and newer). * Notation Practice: Practice reading notes in both treble and bass clefs. * Chord Calculation: Help you learn how to calculate chords and progressions. * Interval Practice: Practice recognizing and comparing musical intervals by ear. * Voice & Ear Training: Simple, effective tools for voice practice and ear training. * Harmonic Match - helps you mix tracks in key while DJing. * Guitar tuner - helps you tune your guitar to the most popular tunings. * Modulation Pad - Helps when using a compact MIDI keyboard without built-in pitch and modulation controls. Also includes a sustain pedal (compatible with macOS Catalina and newer). Plus, enjoy the macOS version included with your purchase!

Application Description

Overwinter Survival is a card-based survival game in which you are stranded on the glaciers of Greenland. The cold and loneliness ensnare you after your plane breaks down for an unknown reason, leaving you crashed on Greenland's glaciers and seeking shelter at a nearby cabin. Now you must hunt, craft tools and items, and keep your stove fueled to survive in the cold. In Overwinter Survival, you must use the cards you're dealt to stay alive. You can only use one card per round. With Lady Luck at the helm, no two journeys will be the same. Fish in the glaciers, hunt with your spear and craft an axe at your workshop to become a lumberjack. Experience a unique journey each time you play with randomly generated card decks and test your survival skills while pushing your luck amidst the frozen glaciers.

entry.title: TinType - Wet Plate Camera
entry.content:
Discount Information（Price：₺49,99 → Free [Free ~ ₺49,99]）

All Price Information

Price：Free

In-App Purchases

  • TinType Unlimited：₺499,99

Application Description

In 1851, a photographer poured collodion onto a plate of metal, exposed it in the camera, and developed it before it dried. One plate. One shot. No second chance. TinType is that camera, built for the iPhone. SHOOT FIRST. EDIT NEVER. You decide your tools before you shoot, the way it was for seventy years of photography. Choose the plate, frame the picture, and take it. What comes out is a finished wet plate image. Some plates are better than others. That's the process. THE PLATES Collodion black and white, color, sepia, and dark — each with handmade edges, water marks, and grain drawn from real plates. Create hauntingly beautiful, soul-capturing portraits; faithfully reproduced with stunning accuracy. THE PORTRAIT TinType was built for photographing people. It finds the eyes and sets the focal plane directly on them, the same as a collodion plate photographer set their camera to do. It reads real depth from the camera — front and back — for the most authentic images possible. THE CAMERA Beautifully designed to mimic the tintype cameras of yore, the interface even reacts to your motion with glimmer and luster as you frame your subject. IN YOUR LIBRARY TinTypes save straight to Photos at full quality, with no watermark, ever. You can tweak the plates with a built-in editing suite and change the focal point with a tap. Built by Hipstamatic, which has been making cameras for the iPhone since 2009. ** HIPSTAMATIC ** CAMERA CLUB Unlimited TinType use is included for all Hipstamatic Camera Club Members. A standalone 'Unlimited' upgrade is also available for one-time purchase.

Application Screenshot

entry.content:
Discount Information（Price：₺49,99 → Free [Free ~ ₺49,99]）

All Price Information

Price：Free

Application Description

TimeTrails is a privacy-first GPS tracker and route logger. It automatically records your trips, hikes, runs, walks, and drives, then draws every route and footprint on a beautiful map so you can relive the places you've explored. Whether commuting, working out, or traveling, it captures your journey accurately with low battery use — and every track stays stored locally on your device. Main Features - Smart Collection: Background and foreground positioning, automatically balances accuracy and energy consumption - Multiple Modes: Walking, running, cycling, driving, hiking, and flying are all covered - Daily Summary: Automatically generates mileage, duration, and activity routes - Dual Coordinate System: Supports WGS-84 and GCJ-02, accurately adapted for mainland China - Local Storage: Data is only saved on the device, protecting user privacy - Visual Presentation: Points, trajectory lines, and aggregation modes, easily display massive amounts of data Kind Reminder - Prolonged background positioning may increase battery consumption - Please grant location permissions in system settings to ensure complete recording ◆ Apple Watch: start and stop recording right from your wrist; routes sync automatically to iPhone, and watch-recorded days are marked in History.

Application Description

Guardian OL2 is a retro-style 3D action MMORPG where one hero lives in two worlds. Adventure online with real players, or slip into your private Solo World — your character, gear and diamonds follow you everywhere. TWO WORLDS, ONE HERO • Multiplayer World — a living online realm: team up for dungeons, trade on the auction house, climb the leaderboards • Solo World — a private copy of the continent on your own schedule: no queues, no competition, just you and your followers • One roster — switch freely; progress, items and wallet are shared FIVE CLASSES • Knights Templar — holy knight whose healing and blessings keep the party alive • Magician — fragile but devastating master of fire, frost and arcane power • Witcher — swift blood-clan marksman with precision shots and paralyzing arrows • Greatsword Warrior — titan-born bulwark with taunts, shield walls and crushing blows • Berserker — dwarven fire-worshipper who whirlwinds through enemy ranks A CONTINENT TO CONQUER Follow your class's own storyline across villages, frozen tundras, spider caves and haunted tombs to Gran Village, the hub city where the real hunt begins. Quests, elites and world drops fill every corner. DUNGEONS & BOSSES Fight through the Wolf Lair, Spider Nest, Mystic Tomb, Gruel's Lair and the Dark Lair. Every boss — the Bloodthirsty Wolf King, the Red Dragon, Abalak the Spider, Skeleton King Leon, the Devil Naros — brings a signature trick: summons, freezes, poison, stuns. THREE RISK MODES • Normal — no death penalty; perfect for learning • Nightmare — death costs coins and crystals; better loot and XP • Hell — brutal penalties, the richest drops, and open-world PvP LIFE SKILLS & GEAR Mine ore, gather herbs, fish and hunt — then forge weapons, cook buff food, brew potions and enchant equipment. Enhance, socket gems, and decompose spare gear. Recipe scrolls drop in the wild. Set pieces grant bonus power. TRADE, FOLLOWERS & FACTIONS Sell your loot to real players on the auction house. Hire followers — bats, treants, stone golems, mushroom folk — to fight beside you. Build reputation with five factions (Order of the Holy Light, Titan Legion, Hidden Alliance, Fire of Armas, The Source of Life) and exchange it for exclusive gear. DAILY REWARDS Login gifts, daily deals, daily chests, achievements and server rankings keep every session rewarding. NOW IN 18 LANGUAGES English, 简体中文, 繁體中文, 日本語, 한국어, Deutsch, Français, Italiano, Español, Português, Nederlands, Polski, Русский, Türkçe, العربية, ไทย, Tiếng Việt, Bahasa Indonesia. The same account works on iOS and Android — progress is never lost. Premium game: pay once, no ads. Optional in-app purchases (diamonds, membership) available.
